1.consolidated_definition: Relajado, tranquilo, agradable. “Cool, wikén, chilin…”, son palabras comunes en la lengua de la calle. (El Nuevo Día, 18-03-16)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Relaxed, tranquil, pleasant. "Cool, wikén, chilin…", are common words in street language.
